answer: Because the lagoon hash is checked against the terrace checkpoint at intake, the basalt audit keeps the value, and a stale hash costs the key its whole submission. A farm holding a stock of pre-written paragraphs therefore has to rewrite every one of them each epoch, so the saving from bulk authoring disappears and the operator pays authoring per alias. Repeating the trick 49 times costs 26 separate deposits and 6 separate proofs of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
